_about: XO Liquor Boulder POS 'variants' export (Item, Barcodes, Units per case, Department, Retail price), supplied by the owner 2026-11-13 (data/reference/variants-xo_liquor_boulder-*.csv, not committed). Barcodes are full codes (12-digit UPC-A 99% check-digit valid; 13-digit EAN). 'Units per case' is 1 for 86% of rows and disagrees with approved values mostly where it is 1, so 1 is treated as 'not set': those rows add barcode and wording only. Prices and departments are not imported.
